posts.title: Hello Kitty
posts.description: Ajin and I checked out the Asia Pop exhibition at the NRW Forum in Düsseldorf. The exhibition focused entirely on modern art from China, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan. From movies and comics to music, it took a close look at everything the East has to offer in terms of soft power. posts.description: Why do I need a phone anyway? Can’t I just put some virtual SIM card into my laptop and use it to make my average three calls per month that way? I could install my banking, university, and transportation apps on my computer. I could save so much money by not having to buy a new phone every couple of years. posts.title: New Faces
posts.description: I’ve lost count of how many times I’ve ended up in a city I don’t know. Every time, I’m suddenly surrounded by new faces. At first, they all look alike, but over time I learn to tell them apart, remember their names and stories, and become aware of the possibilities they reveal to me.
